context_for_next_testing_agent: Analytics Dashboard fully tested and working. Key features verified: 1) GET /api/participants/analytics/detailed - comprehensive analytics with role breakdown, age stats, gender, wing/region distribution, pending payments. 2) GET /api/participants/pending-payments - dedicated endpoint for unpaid participants with contact info. 3) Export endpoints - CSV, Excel single-sheet, and Full Report multi-sheet Excel. 4) Frontend has 4 tabs: Overview (role counts, age stats, gender by role), Demographics (gender, rank distribution, age by squadron/flight), Distribution (wing, region, TN groups, squadron/flight bars), Pending Payments (table with 12 unpaid with contact info). 5) Export dropdown with 3 options.
